spreads.name: Daily Draw
spreads.description: A single card pulled to set the tone of the day, answer a quick question, or invite reflection.

positions.label: Today
positions.meaning: The energy or message for this moment.

spreads.name: Past · Present · Future
spreads.description: A classic three-card spread tracing the arc of a situation across time.

positions.label: Past
positions.meaning: What has shaped this: the foundation underneath.

positions.label: Present
positions.meaning: Where you are right now: the current of the moment.

positions.label: Future
positions.meaning: Where this is heading if the current course holds.

spreads.name: Situation · Action · Outcome
spreads.description: A practical three-card spread for decisions and dilemmas.

positions.label: Situation
positions.meaning: The shape of what's actually in front of you.

positions.label: Action
positions.meaning: The move that wants to be made.

positions.label: Outcome
positions.meaning: What follows from taking that action.

spreads.name: Mind · Body · Spirit
spreads.description: A spread for taking your own temperature, useful for journaling and check-ins.

positions.label: Mind
positions.meaning: What's loud in the head right now.

positions.label: Body
positions.meaning: What the body is carrying or signaling.

positions.label: Spirit
positions.meaning: What the deeper self is reaching toward.

spreads.name: Horseshoe
spreads.description: Seven cards in an arch: situation, influences, and what's ahead.

positions.label: The Past
positions.meaning: What set the stage.

positions.label: The Present
positions.meaning: Where you are now.

positions.label: Hidden Influences
positions.meaning: What's affecting things below the surface.

positions.label: Obstacles
positions.meaning: What stands in the way.

positions.label: External Influences
positions.meaning: How others or the environment are shaping this.

positions.label: Advice
positions.meaning: The counsel the cards offer.

positions.label: Likely Outcome
positions.meaning: Where this is heading on the current path.

spreads.name: Celtic Cross
spreads.description: The most detailed traditional spread: ten cards mapping the situation, its forces, and its trajectory.

positions.label: The Heart
positions.meaning: The core of the situation.

positions.label: The Cross
positions.meaning: What crosses or challenges you.

positions.label: Foundation
positions.meaning: What lies beneath: the basis of the matter.

positions.label: The Past
positions.meaning: What has just passed.

positions.label: Crown
positions.meaning: What is above: your conscious aim.

positions.label: The Near Future
positions.meaning: What is approaching.

positions.label: Self
positions.meaning: How you stand in the situation.

positions.label: Environment
positions.meaning: How others around you affect it.

positions.label: Hopes and Fears
positions.meaning: What you long for, and quietly dread.

positions.label: Outcome
positions.meaning: Where it all leads.

spreads.name: Relationship
spreads.description: Five cards examining the dynamics between you and someone else.

positions.label: You
positions.meaning: What you bring to this connection.

positions.label: Them
positions.meaning: What the other person brings.

positions.label: The Bond
positions.meaning: The shape of what's between you.

positions.label: Strengths
positions.meaning: What is healthy and worth tending.

positions.label: What Needs Attention
positions.meaning: Where care or honesty is asked for.

spreads.name: Year Ahead
spreads.description: Twelve cards arranged as a wheel: one for each month of the coming year.

positions.label: Month 1
positions.meaning: The opening month and its theme.

positions.label: Month 2
positions.meaning: The energy of the second month.

positions.label: Month 3
positions.meaning: The third month's invitation.

positions.label: Month 4
positions.meaning: The fourth month's terrain.

positions.label: Month 5
positions.meaning: The fifth month's lesson.

positions.label: Month 6
positions.meaning: The midpoint and what it asks of you.

positions.label: Month 7
positions.meaning: The seventh month's turning.

positions.label: Month 8
positions.meaning: The eighth month's offering.

positions.label: Month 9
positions.meaning: The ninth month's depth.

positions.label: Month 10
positions.meaning: The tenth month's harvest.

positions.label: Month 11
positions.meaning: The eleventh month's reflection.

positions.label: Month 12
positions.meaning: The closing month and its blessing.
